text.en:
Section 1 of Executive Order No. 342 dated
August 14, 1950, fixing the ceiling prices of commodities
for the different provinces of the Philippines is hereby
amended by excluding drugs, medicines, and household
remedies from the operation thereof. In fixing the pro-
vincial ceiling prices of drugs, medicines, and household
remedies, the following increases to their basic ceiling
prices in Manila shall be allowed:
Zone I, 2 per cent; Zone II, 3 per cent; Zone III, 4 per cent;
Zone IV, 4.5 per cent; and Zone V, 5 per cent: Provided, however,
That in cases of. Kotex, Kleenex, Modess, and Nursing Bottles, in
the Visayan provinces, 3 per cent shall be added and in the Min-
danao provinces, 5 per cent shall be added.
SEc. 4. Section 1 of Executive Order No. 359 dated
November 3, 1950, is hereby amended by eliminating the
producers' ceiling prices.

Section 1 of Executive Order No. 363 dated
November 9, 1950, is hereby amended by eliminating the
word "refined" in the last sentence so as to read as follows:
"Sugar packed in cellophane or cotton
.....…... P0.05 additional per kilo."

This Order shall take effect five days from the
date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of December,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
